newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tricom says share suspension by exchange.
newsitem.headline: Tricom says share suspension by exchange.

text.p: Tricom Holdings Ltd on Monday clarified that trading in the company's shares was suspended at the request of the Hong Kong stock exchange.
Tricom and Star Telecommunications International Holding Ltd said earlier that trading in their shares were suspended in the afternoon session at the companies' request pending an announcement.
Shares of telecommunications operator Star Telecom were up HK$0.20 or 10 percent to HK$2.20 at midday on volume of 4.62 million shares worth HK$9.68 million.
Tricom shares were unchanged at HK$1.95.
Tricom supplies telephone systems, office automation and personal communications products.
